book.tinker_foundry.intro.title: Tinker Foundry Guide
book.tinker_foundry.intro.text: This guide covers only the implemented smelting, fuel, alloying, and casting systems.
book.tinker_foundry.scope.title: Scope
book.tinker_foundry.scope.text: This project does not provide tools, material stats, or modifiers, so those topics are not included.
book.tinker_foundry.melter.title: Melter
book.tinker_foundry.melter.text: The Melter processes a single input. Provide an item and heat; the molten result is stored internally.
book.tinker_foundry.heater.title: Heater
book.tinker_foundry.heater.text: The Heater uses solid fuel to heat an adjacent Melter or Alloyer. Fuel recipes define temperature and duration.
book.tinker_foundry.smeltery.title: Smeltery
book.tinker_foundry.smeltery.text: The Smeltery is a multiblock smelting device that processes multiple inputs and stores multiple fluids.
book.tinker_foundry.smeltery_structure.t: Build the shell from seared blocks, tanks, and a controller. Keep the interior air and place the controller in a valid shell position.
book.tinker_foundry.foundry.title: Foundry
book.tinker_foundry.foundry.text: The Foundry handles larger smelting and casting workflows. It keeps separate products and does not invent undeclared alloy results.
book.tinker_foundry.foundry_structure.te: Build it from scorched blocks, glass, fuel tanks, and a controller. Reopen the menu after changing the structure.
book.tinker_foundry.casting.title: Casting
book.tinker_foundry.casting.text: Place a Casting Table or Basin below a faucet and use a matching cast to turn stored fluid into an item.
book.tinker_foundry.molding.title: Sand and Metal Casts
book.tinker_foundry.molding.text: Sand casts are consumed after use while metal casts are reusable. The active casting or molding recipe defines the output.
book.tinker_foundry.alloying.title: Alloying
book.tinker_foundry.alloying.text: The Alloyer checks multiple inputs, target temperature, and catalyst inputs before consuming materials.
book.tinker_foundry.entity_melting.title: Entity Melting
book.tinker_foundry.entity_melting.text: Entity melting has a data recipe entry point; entity types, effects, and fluids are defined by each recipe.
book.tinker_foundry.fuel.title: Fuel
book.tinker_foundry.fuel.text: Fuel tanks heat structures. Fuel recipes define temperature, burn amount, and consumption speed; fluids without a recipe are invalid fuel.
book.tinker_foundry.tanks.title: Tanks and Fluids
book.tinker_foundry.tanks.text: Material tanks store molten fluids, fuel tanks provide heat, and casting tanks transfer containers. Ports and ducts transfer through adjacent structures.
